title: Is the Upside Worth the Risk in Amazon Stock Right Now in October?
creator: Parkevtate Vosianc CFA
source_note: Detailed summary generated from video captions (manual English captions)
summary: Parkevtate Vosianc asks whether Amazon is a buy in October. The bull case: revenue growth accelerated to 20%, operating income +43%, and AWS is the driver — 36.7% growth (five straight accelerating quarters, fastest in 18 quarters) at ~40% operating margins versus <10% in e-commerce, with a ~$496B backlog growing triple digits. His key chart shows total assets soaring from ~$100B (2017) to over $1T while return on invested capital hits record highs — a rare feat at that scale, which he contrasts with Starbucks' declining ROIC. Proprietary chips (Graviton/Trainium) run at a $25B annual revenue rate, up triple digits; AI revenue run-rate also exceeds $25B. The bear case: two years of negative free cash flow ahead (his DCF: -$34B this year, -$5.6B next) before inflecting in 2028, which he believes will be hyperscalers' final year of rising data-center capex. At a forward P/E of 24 against 20% revenue and 43% op-income growth, he finds it attractive. Call: AMZN BUY — named one of his top 10 stocks to buy now; he recently doubled his own position and wants to add more. Reiteration of his Oct 5 BUY; no flip.
